title: State code numbers of top 3 yougest drivers. How many Netherlandic drivers
question:
State code numbers of top 3 yougest drivers. How many Netherlandic drivers among them?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: youngest driver refers to Max (year(dob)); Netherlandic and Dutch refer to the same country

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN d.XCL_041 = 'Dutch' THEN 1 END) AS dutch_count
FROM (
  SELECT XCL_034
  FROM drivers
  WHERE XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY XCL_040 DESC
  LIMIT 3
) AS top3
JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = top3.XCL_034

SELECT XCL_036,
       SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_041 = 'Dutch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dutch_count

  SELECT XCL_036, XCL_041

  ORDER BY XCL_040 DESC
  LIMIT 3
